analysis.summary: RBZ Jewellers Limited reported revenue of INR121 crores for Q1 FY27, reflecting a 60% year-on-year growth driven by consumer demand and higher jewellery sales. EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR18 crores with a margin of 14.9%, while profit after tax was INR9 crores. Management detailed retail store expansion plans in Gujarat including Surat, Rajkot, Gandhinagar, and Maninagar across the second and third quarters of FY27. Additionally, the company outlined its long-term strategic shift towards increasing retail contribution, exploring the franchise model, and gradually hedging inventory using Gold Metal Loans. RBZ Jewellers Limited released its Q1FY27 investor presentation, reporting an operational revenue of INR 1,208 million and an EBITDA of INR 180 million with a 14.9% margin.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the B2B to B2C revenue mix is targeted to be 50-50 in a year or two and 75-25 in the long term, with retail comprising 75%.
guidance.quote: For revenue mix, we see that job work percentage right now in Quarter 1 stands at 54% and, the mix has to, I think the B2B to B2C mix has to be 50-50 or so in a year or two and in long term it will be 75-25, 75 being retail.

guidance.claim: Management noted that revenue growth was in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter.
guidance.quote: Delivered a healthy quarterly performance, with revenue growth in line with the guidance shared in the previous quarter, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the demand and order book levels for the B2B side are strong for the upcoming quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: So right now, company is very much in line with the orders that we are receiving, and I hope that the response continues further.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that IIJS experienced warm and encouraging buyer growth and good order backing.
demand_outlook.quote: So IIJS has been really warm this time, like it was really good this time. It was encouraging and we have seen a buyer growth. We have seen a good order backing.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1FY27 revenue increased by approximately 60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue increased by ~60% year-on-year, driven by robust customer demand, higher jewellery sales, and strengthening brand recall.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that they continue to witness steady consumer demand in the occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness steady consumer demand in occasion wear segment ahead of the wedding season, while also optimizing our inventory mix with a greater focus on lightweight and budget-friendly product offering to cater to evolving consumer preference.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the month of April has been very good.
demand_outlook.quote: Now how has been April? April has been very good.

capex_expansion.claim: The Surat store is scheduled to launch in Quarter 2, while Rajkot, Maninagar, and Gandhinagar stores will be launched in Quarter 3.
capex_expansion.quote: Okay. So, Surat will be launching in Quarter 2 and Rajkot in early Quarter 3. And same, I think Maninagar and Gandhinagar both will be launched in Quarter 3 itself. So three stores in Quarter 3 and one store in Quarter 2, that is Surat.

capex_expansion.claim: Large format stores have a carpet area of around 10,000 square feet with inventory deployment between INR125 crores and INR150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The large format stores are typically around 10,000 square feet carpet area and mid format stores are 5,000 square feet carpet area. The inventory deployment in large format stores is typically around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Small format stores have an inventory deployment of around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10% to 15%.
capex_expansion.quote: While in small format stores are around INR50 crores, plus and minus 10%, 15%.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure break-even for the stores is expected to be achieved in a year or less.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex when you say about the break-even point, the capex break-even will be achieved in a year or less.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure incurred for the Surat store is approximately INR10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Approximately INR10 crores is the capex incurred for Surat store.

capex_expansion.claim: Retail expansion includes flagship showrooms in Surat and Rajkot, alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar and Gandhinagar.
capex_expansion.quote: Retail expansion remains on track, with flagship showrooms in Surat (by Q2) and Rajkot (by early Q3), alongside mid-sized stores in Maninagar (Ahmedabad East) and Gandhinagar, aimed at strengthening geographic presence and enhancing direct customer access across high-growth Gujarat markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to expand its retail presence in Rajkot, Surat, and Ahmedabad.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also planning to expand our retail presence in Rajkot, Surat and Ahmedabad as well.

capex_expansion.claim: Surat and Rajkot showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the retail front, encouraged by the strong performance of our Ahmedabad store, we are now planning to expand in other key Gujarat markets, including Surat and Rajkot, both the showrooms are targeted to commence operations by quarter 2 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is actively exploring strategic locations in Eastern Ahmedabad and Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, we are actively exploring strategic location in Eastern Ahmedabad and nearby cities such as Gandhinagar for mid-sized stores of around 5,000 square feet and aimed at strengthening the regional presence and driving incremental growth.

capex_expansion.claim: A typical large format store will need an inventory of somewhere around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: A typical large format store will need an inventory of somewhere around INR125 crores to INR150 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for the quarter was INR18 crores with an EBITDA margin of 14.9%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter is INR18 crores reflecting a healthy growth of 39% Y-o-Y, with EBITDA margins coming in a healthy 14.9%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter was INR9 crores, translating to a PAT margin of 7.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter has been 28% at INR9 crores translating PAT at 7.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that lease asset amortization stood at INR76 lakhs and lease liabilities impact at INR115 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: One is that the average gold rate has remained stagnant and thus there is negligible inventory gain in the system as of now. So, on the Quarter 1 side the EBITDA margins have reflected that. There is other two impacts that are there: The amortization of lease assets is INR76 lakhs and the impact of lease liabilities is at INR115 lakhs.

margins_costs.claim: For the financial year 2026, EBITDA margins improved to 14.44% with an expansion of 233 basis points.
margins_costs.quote: For the financial year 2026, revenue from operations stood at INR637 crores, reflecting the growth of 20% year-on-year. EBITDA for the year increased significantly by 43% to INR92 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 14.44% and expansion of 233 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: The total factory capacity remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year, while consumption is around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs, utilizing the factory at about 50% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: The total capacity still remains at around 1.8 to 2 tons a year. And the production that we are doing or the consumption that we are able to do is somewhere around 900 kgs to 1000 kgs. So, we are utilizing factory at around 50% of capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: During core season times like July, August, and September, factory capacity utilization generally goes to 70%-80% minimum and sometimes near 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the season times, currently as of now, our capacity utilization generally goes at 70%, 80% minimum, 75%, 85% sometimes, depending on which days are all, sometimes it is near to 90% or so.

orders_capacity.claim: The company targets maximum utilization of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Targeting maximum utilisation of existing manufacturing capacity by FY26
The capacity utilization is approximately 50% or 55%.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we launched 730 new designs averaging 8 designs per day, primarily in occasion wear segment further strengthening our product portfolio

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company has a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores which is sufficient for the four stores coming in the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: Given that we have a sanctioned debt of around INR300 crores. And we are yet to utilize it, which is sufficient for the four stores that is coming in this financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: Management expects the debt-to-equity ratio to remain below 1:1, specifically around 0.8 to 1, by the end of the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: By the end of this financial year, we will be still below 1:1 ratio. I guess 0.8 will be debt and 1 equity.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they want to keep debt levels at a 1:1 ratio ideally or leverage it to 1.4, 1.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We want to stay -- we want to keep the debt levels at 1:1 ratio ideally or 1:1 point, maybe leverage to 1.4, 1.5.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that customs duty increases and advanced authorization events are very immediate, and they take time to understand market and consumer reactions.
risks_headwinds.quote: So see, these are very immediate events or it has just been a few days that these all things are happening. And generally, we would take some time, let's say, a week or 2, in fact, a little bit more to understand what -- how the market and the consumers are reacting.

management_commitments.quote: So we have introduced this since December, our sales mix in corporate, before it was 100% 22 carat, I see by the end of this year, it will be at least 20% will be of 18 caratage.
